title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
summary: Raskolnikov, a poor former student in St Petersburg, convinces himself that killing a pawnbroker is justified. The book follows his guilt, fever and cat-and-mouse conversations with an investigator.
readIf: you want a psychological crime story that is deep, urgent and philosophical.
skipIf: you want a quick detective plot, since the crime is committed early and the rest is inner struggle.

pairings.reason: The same author's biggest novel, about faith, guilt and a family wrecked by a murder.
A very short, cold novel about a man who kills and does not fit society's expectations of remorse.
A modern story of intellectuals who convince themselves a murder can be justified.
